help.title: About this register
help.feed: Newest records come first. Older records are added at the bottom on request; filter by place to narrow the list.
help.record: Adding a record takes two parts: the place, then the bird, the number, the day and comments. Unsent answers stay in this browser.
help.review: Any member may mark a record as doubtful from its page, or mark it verified again. Doubtful records stay listed but never count towards totals.
help.tallies: The totals add up the verified records listed so far, overall and per place.
